overview_description.description: Fathom Protocol is a comprehensive DeFi platform providing liquidity solutions to both retail and institutional participants. Users can deposit XDC and staked XDC to mint FXD, USD stablecoin, which can be used to gain exposure to yield opportunities through our RWA Vaults and Trade Finance Pools. Crypto and RWA holders can also borrow FXD using their assets as collateral.

about_short_description.short_description: Fathom Protocol is a decentralized finance (DeFi) platform.

product.name: FXD Stablecoin
product.description: A USD-pegged stablecoin minted by depositing XDC as collateral, used for borrowing, lending, and trading within the Fathom ecosystem.

product.name: Fathom Liquidity Protocol
product.description: A decentralized finance platform enabling users to mint FXD stablecoin, deposit assets, borrow FXD, and access liquidity through RWA Vaults and Trade Finance Pools.

product.name: FTHM Governance Token
product.description: A governance token that holders can stake to participate in protocol governance, including voting on development, collateral onboarding, and revenue distribution.

product.name: Fathom DEX
product.description: A stableswap decentralized exchange within the Fathom ecosystem for converting FXD stablecoin to other assets and facilitating liquidity.

identifier.value: RWA Vaults and Trade Finance Pools

product.name: RWA Vaults and Trade Finance Pools
product.description: On-chain vaults and pools that allow users to earn yield by staking FXD stablecoin, backed by real-world assets and trade finance instruments.
